Automotive Cybersecurity is mapped to cybersecurity. It could instead be read as domain knowledge, so it is flagged.
'agentic AI toolchains' is mapped to agents and flagged.
AWS/Azure form group 1: the slash offers alternatives for the cloud ask, and cloud stays outside the group.
GitHub Actions/GitLab CI form group 2 because the slash offers alternatives.
Docker/Kubernetes are not grouped. Docker answers the containerization ask and Kubernetes the orchestration ask, so the most literal reading is two separate asks. Flagged.
Terraform and Ansible are not grouped. They are listed with commas and no 'or', which I read as asked together. Flagged.
The raw_text for Terraform and Ansible quotes the requirements-list span 'Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions'. This keeps it distinct from the responsibilities mention 'Terraform, Ansible)'. The same reasoning applies to 'as well as CI/CD'.
'commercial and open-source technologies' is not mapped to open-source-llms because it does not name LLMs.
The static/dynamic code analysis, fuzzing and penetration testing examples have no taxonomy entry, so they are in unmapped.
Seniority 'Several years' does not give a number. It is read as roughly 3+ years and inferred as mid. Flagged.
'or a comparable IT-related field' widens the field, not the requirement, so degree_or_equivalent is false.
